prompt.en: About how many black Loyalists came north seeking a better life?
prompt.fr: Environ combien de loyalistes noirs sont venus vers le nord à la recherche d'une vie meilleure?

explanation.en: About 3,000 black Loyalists, both free people and slaves, came north seeking a better life. In 1792 some black Nova Scotians who had been given poor land went on to found Freetown in Sierra Leone.
explanation.fr: Environ 3 000 loyalistes noirs, à la fois des personnes libres et des esclaves, sont venus vers le nord à la recherche d'une vie meilleure. En 1792, des Néo-Écossais noirs à qui on avait donné de mauvaises terres sont partis fonder Freetown, en Sierra Leone.

source.quote: About 3,000 black Loyalists, freedmen and slaves, came north seeking a better life.

verification.evidence: About 3,000 black Loyalists, freedmen and slaves, came north seeking a better life. In turn, in 1792, some black Nova Scotians, who were given poor land, moved on to establish Freetown, Sierra Leone (West Africa), a new British colony for freed slaves.
